notes.note: Traced Station Tools OAuth through managed paste-back, account expiry and engine proxy. The scoped regression reproduced premature sign-in before the fix and 99 OAuth tests passed after it. An isolated T3 Nightly pair accepted registration and read-only approval, served project and thread calls, withheld a linked target after unlink, and refused a revoked grant before a new approval restored reads. The smoke exercised Station server components and the MCP client; browser, provider and hosted journeys remain unverified.
